text: I've told people before, they're like, oh, you hate all men. I'm like, I've never said that, but if the shoe fits, wear it. I don't give a fuck. But also, like, yeah, don't you? Haven't you ever spent time with one? They're fucking awful. Like, like, have you ever seen a group of guys out like all straight dudes and they're all laughing? Have you ever been like, God, I wonder what they're laughing at? No. When they're laughing, I'm going, the fuck are they doing? Something bad. I'm like, they probably just hit a woman. They're probably high fiving over a slur. True. I bet. That's what I think. When I see men doing it, I'm like, what are you laughing at? What's so funny? What did you do? The state of the world? Turn on the news. I bet you wouldn't be laughing so hard. I'm just harassing them. So let me get this straight. Couple of guys laughing together automatically means they must have done something wrong or they just hit a woman. This isn't a joke. It is straight up hating on men with a smile. What is crazy is how normal they sound saying it. No hesitation, no self-awareness, just casual contempt. And you know what's funny? Most guys that are mocking are probably just hanging out, laughing about work, life, maybe sports, normal stuff. But for women like this, men having fun looks like a threat. That's how deep the resentment goes. They can't stand seeing men happy or at peace. Here's the reality. Men are not the enemy. Most guys are just living their lives, working hard, trying to find some peace, trying to laugh with their friends. If you see that and it makes you angry, that says more about your mindset than it does about men. But here's the thing, guys. Don't let women like this define your view of all women. Yeah, there are bitter, hateful ones out there. And sadly, they do get attention. But not every woman is like this. There are women who respect men, who don't see them as enemies, who understand that men and women need each other. Those are the ones you should focus on. Ignore the noise, block the toxicity and keep working on yourself. Build your life, your confidence, your value, so that when you meet a woman who actually appreciates good men, you'll be ready for her. The best revenge on bitterness like this isn't hate. It's success, peace and finding someone who is on your level.
